If AI causes a mistake in your work, a claim could follow. It is worth asking your insurer what your policy covers.
whats.Quad must safeguard freedom of choice an: Talk of secure supply chains is a reminder to know where your key tools and suppliers come from, and to have options.
whats.Bounteous expands Bengaluru office to st: A firm is growing its Bengaluru office for AI services and global delivery, so more local help may be available for companies adopting AI.
whats.How voice AI is transforming banking and: Voice AI is being used in banking and insurance, so customers may talk to software more often. Think about how your own calls are handled.
whats.HD Hyundai Robotics partners with Palant: Expect more tie-ups between robot makers and AI software firms. When you buy technology, ask vendors who their partners are.

term.def: Voice AI is software that listens to a person speaking, understands the request and replies in a natural voice. Banks and insurers use it to handle customer calls.

prompt.prompt: Act as a business risk advisor. List ten ways AI tools could cause a loss in a [type of business] company. For each, name who is affected and one question to ask our insurer.

quiz.q: The Business Journals reports that AI is already creating insurance claims.
quiz.why: The headline says so and asks if your business is covered. It is a good prompt to ask your insurer what your policy says about AI.

quiz.q: The Korea Times reports that HD Hyundai Robotics has partnered with Palantir on AI solutions.
quiz.why: This is what the headline says. It shows robot makers and AI software firms are teaming up.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds confident, its answer is probably correct.
quiz.why: AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Always check important facts, numbers and names before you use them.

quiz.q: You need to know coding to use AI tools well at work.
quiz.why: Most AI tools work with plain language. Clear instructions matter more than programming skills for most manager tasks.

quiz.q: What you type into a public AI tool may be stored by the provider, depending on its settings.
quiz.why: Many tools keep chats and some may use them to improve their service. Avoid pasting confidential data unless your company has approved the tool.
